name_reason: Already fully compliant: data_fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> with battle-core prefix data_fd2_battle_, descriptor 'character_growth_table' accurately reflects content (per-character/per-portrait stat-growth data) and data type (const lookup table/array). No Ghidra address residue (no trailing hex matching 0x620a1 or any data address). No embedded domain ID in the name that needs scrutiny.
purpose: Read-only per-portrait stat-growth table consumed when initializing/leveling battle characters; supplies per-level random-roll bounds for AP/DP/DX/HP/MP plus a spell-learning-table index.
logic_summary: 68 entries of struct character_growth (11-byte stride), indexed by portrait id 0..67 via accessor fd2_get_char_growth_entry @ 0x4E4DE (base + idx*0xB, returns &entry.ap_min). Consumers read single bytes off the returned pointer. Battle-spawn path (fd2_init_runtime_char_for_battle @ 0x10C50) and recruit path (fd2_init_runtime_char_from_base_growth @ 0x112A5) use +0/+2/+4/+6/+8 (the *_min bytes) as per-level stat coefficients (base + growth*level). Level-up path (fd2_process_xp_and_level_up_for_char @ 0x1E292) passes pGrowth+0/+2/+4/+6/+8 to fd2_roll_stat_gain_and_show_message, which uses the *_min byte and the adjacent *_max byte as inclusive bounds of a per-level random roll, and uses +0xA (spell_learning_idx, !=0xFF) to index the spell-learning table @ 0x626B3 via fd2_get_spell_learning_entry. Class-promotion path fd2_execute_class_promotion_with_dialog @ 0x31602 also reads it.
datatype: const character_growth[68] (11-byte packed struct; 748 bytes total). Fields: ap_min(+0), ap_max(+1), dp_min(+2), dp_max(+3), dx_min(+4), dx_max(+5), hp_min(+6), hp_max(+7), mp_min(+8), mp_max(+9), spell_learning_idx(+0xA).
element_semantics: Each entry = per-level stat-growth profile for one portrait id. (*_min, *_max) byte pairs at +0/+2/+4/+6/+8 are the inclusive random-roll bounds for AP/DP/DX/HP/MP gained per level (in the spawn/recruit coefficient paths only the *_min byte is used as a direct per-level multiplier). spell_learning_idx (+0xA) is an index into data_fd2_battle_spell_learning_table (0xFF = character learns no spells).
notes: Data address (not a function): get_plate_comment correctly returns 'No function at address'; no data plate exists/needed. is_const confirmed by xrefs_to (single DATA ref from accessor fd2_get_char_growth_entry @ 0x4E4DE) and by inspecting readers fd2_init_runtime_char_for_battle @ 0x10C50 and fd2_process_xp_and_level_up_for_char @ 0x1E292 (read-only). Raw bytes at 0x620a1 (06 08 04 06 02 03 08 0c 00 00 ff ...) are byte-identical to the C initializer; struct character_growth in src/include/types.h matches. KB sample addresses (FD2.LE 0x55EA1) drift between builds; the 11-byte stride + 68-entry count + field layout are the stable anchors and all match this binary. Existing src comment block (btltab3.c lines 794-810) is already precise, accurate, ASCII-only, and consistent with the accessor's Ghidra plate; no edit made, so name_verdict=keep and comment_verdict=keep mean no source change in this shard's commit (only the shard file is staged).
